analysis.insight_summary: A user is trying to use [product_name] to control home lighting via smartphone but faces an issue where the app download link is outdated or unavailable. Although community members direct them to manuals and official documentation, the absence of a working app download disrupts progress and creates confusion regarding their smart home project.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to easily locate, download, and install the [product_name] app to control home devices from their phone, as outlined in official guidance.
